children: may test a resistance at $97.95 per barrel, a break above could lead to a gain to $102.62.

The contract has climbed above a wedge and a resistance at $94.18. The wedge indicates a target around $117. Wave pattern suggests the progress of a wave C from $78.20, which is expected to travel into the range of $97.95 to $110.16.
A realistic target will be $102.62, the 76.4% projection level of this wave C. A break below $94.18, now a support, may trigger a fall into the range of $84.75 to $90.41.

On the hourly chart, a projection analysis on the uptrend from $86.22 reveals more fine-tuned resistances and supports. The nearest resistance zone is from $97.10-$97.71, which close to $97.95 (daily chart).
It is not very clear if the market could overcome this resistance zone at its first attempt. Given that a small five-wave cycle might be ending, the zone may hold and trigger a shallow correction.
